_comment: Elk. The largest thing in a northern wood and the difference between a hunting people eating through February and not: one of them is a month of meat. There are never many.

label: Elk

_comment: Bear. It takes what it finds, which in a bad autumn is somebody's flock. Killing one is dangerous work that the community does because of what it costs to leave it alive - and the hide is the warmest thing anybody owns.
name: bear
label: Bear
